'''Showdown: Four Lights Supplemental''' is the 53rd virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on December 8, 2023. The set consists of 27 cards.

==Type Breakdown==
*5 [[:Category:Dilemma (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Dilemma]]
*3 [[:Category:Equipment (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Equipment]]
*2 [[:Category:Event (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Event]]
*1 [[:Category:Interrupt (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Interrupt]]
*1 [[:Category:Mission (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Mission]]
*1 [[:Category:Objective (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Objective]]
*10 [[:Category:Personnel (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Personnel]] (4 Cardassian, and 6 Federation)
*4 [[:Category:Ship (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Ship]] (1 Cardassian and 3 Federation)

==Rarity Breakdown==
*27 [[:Category:Virtual (Star Trek CCG 1E)|Virtual]]
